title: GMP / Semi-GMP Reactors
desc: Process reactors designed around hygienic construction requirements.
principle: Mixing and temperature control are designed around the batch and the required cleaning strategy.
application: Pharmaceutical intermediates and formulated liquids
features: Drainable geometry, cleaning connections and access points as specified

title: Limpet Coil Reactors
desc: Reaction vessels with external half-pipe coils for thermal circulation.
principle: A thermal fluid circulates through a half-pipe coil welded to the shell, transferring heat through the vessel wall.
application: Batch heating and cooling
features: Half-pipe coil, thermal-fluid connections and agitated vessel

title: Autoclave Reactors
desc: Closed reactors for specified batch duties under pressure.
principle: An enclosed chamber contains the batch during a controlled reaction.
application: Batch reaction and process development.
features: Pressure chamber, closure, process nozzles and service connections

title: Shell & Tube Heat Exchanger
desc: Indirect heat transfer through a tube bundle and shell.
principle: Two fluids exchange heat through tube walls while flowing through separate shell-side and tube-side circuits.
application: Process cooling, heating and heat recovery
features: Shell, tube bundle, tubesheets, channel heads and baffles

title: Box Type Heat Exchanger
desc: Compact box-format equipment for indirect heat transfer.
principle: Separate flow paths exchange heat through metal surfaces.
application: Process heating or cooling where a box-format assembly suits the layout.
features: Box-shaped casing, heat-transfer surfaces and process connections

title: Reboiler
desc: Heat transfer equipment supporting vapor generation in separation systems.
principle: Heat supplied to column bottoms produces vapor that returns to the separation column.
application: Distillation and solvent recovery
features: Vapor return, liquid inlet and heating service connections

title: Distillation Columns
desc: Vertical process equipment for separation and mass transfer.
principle: Vapor and liquid contact across trays or packing to transfer components between phases.
application: Fractionation and solvent recovery
features: Column shell, internals supports and process nozzles

title: High Pressure Vessel
desc: Fabricated containment equipment for specified industrial pressure duties.
principle: The enclosed shell and heads contain process media at the design conditions specified for the duty.
application: Gas or liquid containment under specified conditions
features: Shell, dished ends, support and connections

title: Stainless Steel / Mild Steel / Carbon Steel Storage Tank
desc: Storage tanks in specified stainless, mild or carbon steel construction.
principle: A containment shell holds liquid between upstream and downstream operations.
application: Bulk liquid storage and process buffering
features: Tank shell, vent connections, drain and access provisions

title: Vertical / Horizontal Storage Tank
desc: Storage tanks configured to suit available space and process requirements.
principle: A vertical or horizontal shell stores liquid according to footprint, headroom and access constraints.
application: Utility and process liquid storage
features: Legs, skirt or saddles appropriate to the selected orientation

title: Vertical / Horizontal Receivers
desc: Receiver vessels arranged vertically or horizontally to fit the installation.
principle: The vessel provides buffer volume between upstream and downstream services.
application: Process buffer storage and compressed-gas service where specified.
features: Vessel shell, nozzles, access and mounting provisions

title: Underground Storage Tank
desc: Storage tank construction for specified underground installation conditions.
principle: A below-grade vessel holds liquid with transfer and monitoring typically accessible at grade.
application: Below-grade utility or process liquid storage
features: Access risers, vent connections and installation-specific protection

title: Insulated Storage Tank
desc: Storage vessels with hygienic or thermal insulation requirements as specified.
principle: Insulation limits heat exchange with the surroundings while the storage shell contains the product.
application: Temperature-sensitive process and hygienic storage duties
features: Insulated shell, product connections and access

title: Rotocone Vacuum Dryer (RCVD)
desc: Rotating conical vacuum drying equipment for suitable solid products.
principle: A rotating double-cone vessel tumbles solids under vacuum while heat reaches the product through the wall.
application: Vacuum drying of suitable wet solids
features: Double-cone body, rotary coupling and vacuum connection

title: Rotary Vacuum Dryer (RVD)
desc: Rotary equipment for drying under vacuum.
principle: A rotating or internally agitated chamber renews solids exposure to heated surfaces under vacuum.
application: Drying powders and granules with limited thermal exposure
features: Drying chamber, drive, heating and vacuum connections

title: Fluid Bed Dryer (FBD)
desc: Drying equipment using a fluidized bed of particles.
principle: Air passes through a distributor and suspends particles, carrying away moisture.
application: Drying granules and powders suited to fluidization
features: Air distributor, product bowl and exhaust filtration

title: Vacuum Tray Dryer (VTD)
desc: Tray-based drying equipment operating under specified vacuum conditions.
principle: Product rests on trays in an evacuated heated chamber, reducing the temperature needed for evaporation.
application: Static batch drying of heat-sensitive solids
features: Vacuum chamber, shelves, trays and sealed door

title: Air Tray Dryer
desc: Tray drying equipment using heated air circulation.
principle: Heated air circulates across trays and carries away evaporated moisture.
application: Batch drying of suitable powders, granules or solids
features: Insulated chamber, tray racks and recirculating air path

title: Agitated Nutsche Filter Dryer (ANFD)
desc: Equipment integrating solid-liquid filtration, washing and drying duties.
principle: Pressure differential draws liquid through a filter plate. An agitator can redistribute cake for washing and drying.
application: Solid–liquid separation, cake washing and vacuum drying
features: Filter plate, sealed vessel, lift drive and cake discharge

title: Nutsche Filter (NF)
desc: Batch solid-liquid separation through a supported filter medium.
principle: Pressure differential drives liquid through the filter medium while solids remain as cake.
application: Separation and washing of solids in chemical or pharmaceutical processing.
features: Filter vessel, supported filter medium and filtrate outlet

title: Ribbon Blender
desc: Horizontal blending equipment for compatible powders and bulk solids.
principle: Inner and outer helical ribbons move powder in opposing axial directions within a trough.
application: Dry powder blending and compatible low-liquid formulations
features: Trough, ribbon shaft, drive and discharge gate

title: Octagonal Blender
desc: Rotating octagonal vessel for bulk material blending.
principle: The rotating polygonal chamber lifts and tumbles particles to redistribute them.
application: Gentle blending of free-flowing powders or granules
features: Faceted chamber, trunnion mounts and discharge

title: Double Cone Blender
desc: Rotating double-cone equipment for blending powders and granules.
principle: Two opposed cones continuously divide and recombine the powder bed as the vessel rotates.
application: Dry blending of flowable materials
features: Double-conical body, supports and charge/discharge ports
